label: Phase 1 · Project foundation
detail: Create the Next.js App Router project, TypeScript configuration, test setup, responsive page shell, and core design tokens.

label: Phase 2 · Game-state model
detail: Define serializable ball, paddle, score, match, difficulty, and input state with explicit defaults and reset rules.

label: Phase 3 · Deterministic simulation
detail: Build the fixed-step loop, paddle movement, serves, scoring, match completion, and deterministic engine fixtures.

label: Phase 4 · Collision system
detail: Implement wall and paddle collision response, penetration correction, bounded rebound angles, velocity caps, and edge-case unit tests.

label: Phase 5 · Responsive court
detail: Add the Canvas renderer, coordinate scaling, resize handling, semantic DOM score HUD, and stable animation lifecycle.

label: Phase 6 · Controls and local modes
detail: Normalize keyboard, pointer, and touch input; add pause, resume, restart, player-versus-CPU, and local two-player flows.

label: Phase 7 · CPU and game feel
detail: Add three CPU profiles, progressive speed tuning, sound controls, readable feedback, and measurable gameplay tuning tools.

label: Phase 8 · Accessibility and resilience
detail: Add reduced motion, high-contrast cues, focus management, status announcements, visibility pause, safe-area support, and real-device checks.

label: Phase 9 · Verification and release candidate
detail: Pass engine, component, browser, performance, responsive, and accessibility gates, then produce the static export candidate.
